news.headline: What to Expect From uniQure's Upcoming Huntington's Gene Therapy Readout
news.summary: STAT previewed uniQure's promised four-year (48-month) Phase I/II follow-up data on AMT-130, covering 24 patients (12 high-dose, 12 low-dose) plus 3 additional high-dose patients with 3-year follow-up, due before the end of September 2026. Because AMT-130 is delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and Navigation System, the readout is a direct read-through catalyst for CLPT shares.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Submission of Biologics License Application for AMT-130 (Ifezuntirgene Inilparvovec) in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: uniQure formally submitted its BLA to the FDA for AMT-130 under the accelerated approval pathway, a milestone the company had targeted for Q3 2026; AMT-130 is administered intracranially using ClearPoint Neuro's proprietary navigation system and SmartFlow cannula. AMT-130 holds Breakthrough Therapy, RMAT and Fast Track designations and is the first Huntington's disease program to hold both Breakthrough and RMAT status.

news.headline: Compass Financial Management LLC Buys New Position in ClearPoint Neuro, Inc.
news.summary: A newly disclosed Q2 2026 Form 13F showed Compass Financial Management LLC establishing a new stake of roughly 295,680 CLPT shares, adding to a broader trend of rising institutional ownership (now estimated near 52.8% of shares outstanding) even as the stock traded well below its 52-week high.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue came in at $10.9 million, up 18% year-over-year but about $1.8 million below the $12.7 million consensus estimate, with neurosurgery navigation/therapy revenue up 62% to $5.6 million; adjusted loss of $0.38/share missed the expected $0.29 loss as opex rose 51% to $17.0 million, widening the net loss to $11.3 million. Shares fell roughly 15% after-hours to about $13, and the company reaffirmed full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $52-56 million.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Unveils Five-Pillar Strategy Targeting $500 Million in Annual Revenue
news.summary: Alongside the Q2 miss, management laid out a longer-term roadmap to $500 million in annual revenue built around five pillars, including the CAL (ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories) preclinical CRO buildout in Torrey Pines (targeted at $60M+ revenue at scale versus ~$8M from the prior subleased site) and expansion into focused ultrasound and robotics.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro: Regulatory Momentum Strengthens The Long-Term Investment Case
news.summary: An analyst piece argued that despite the Q2 revenue miss, cumulative regulatory progress across CLPT's roughly 60 active biopharma partners (including uniQure's AMT-130 nearing BLA submission) strengthens the long-term bull case for the company's neuro-navigation and delivery platform.

catalysts.label: uniQure four-year AMT-130 Phase I/II data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure has committed to presenting topline four-year (48-month) follow-up data on 24 Huntington's disease patients (12 high-dose, 12 low-dose), plus 3-year data on 3 additional high-dose patients, before the end of September 2026. Management has indicated the analysis will benchmark against an expanded ~26,000-patient Enroll-HD comparator population. As AMT-130 is delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and Navigation System, the data is the single largest near-term share-price catalyst for CLPT.

catalysts.label: FDA review of uniQure's AMT-130 BLA (accelerated approval)
catalysts.detail: Following the September 2, 2026 BLA submission under the accelerated approval pathway, FDA review and a potential decision would typically follow over the subsequent 6-12+ months (standard or priority review timeline not yet disclosed). A positive outcome would be the clearest validation yet of ClearPoint's neuro-delivery platform and could drive follow-on commercial device/procedure revenue.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro is expected to report Q3 2026 financial results in early November 2026 (estimated around November 5, based on prior-year timing), which will update progress against full-year guidance of $52-56 million in revenue and provide commentary on CAL facility ramp and partner pipeline activity. Exact date not yet formally announced by the company.

catalysts.label: CAL (ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories) preclinical CRO ramp
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint took possession of its new Torrey Pines preclinical lab facility (CAL) in July 2026 and has begun signing statements of work, including a first GLP-services SOW expected to complete in H1 2027. Management has framed CAL as a pillar of its long-term $500 million revenue target, targeting a $300+ million addressable CRO/preclinical services market.

catalysts.label: Potential commercial approval of first partnered gene/cell therapy using ClearPoint delivery
catalysts.detail: Analysts (e.g., B. Riley) have flagged that a wave of FDA rare-disease guidance reversals reopens the door to partner BLA submissions in 2026 with possible commercial approvals as early as 2027, which would be the first true commercial validation event for ClearPoint's delivery platform across its ~60-partner ecosystem.

pulse: CLPT trades in the low-to-mid teens (around $13-14, versus a 52-week high near $30), with a market cap of roughly $400-410 million after its Q2 2026 revenue miss ($10.9M vs. $12.7M consensus) triggered a sharp August sell-off. The dominant near-term catalyst is uniQure's promised four-year AMT-130 Phase I/II data, due before the end of September 2026, following uniQure's September 2 BLA submission for the Huntington's disease therapy that is delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and Navigation System. The broader narrative remains a high-beta proxy on partner (especially uniQure) regulatory progress, balanced against execution risk on the company's new $500M long-term revenue plan, CAL preclinical CRO buildout, and reaffirmed but tighter FY2026 guidance of $52-56 million.
